{{small|6 games}} |prevseason=[[2016–17 Argentine Primera División|2016–17]] |nextseason=[[2018–19 Superliga Argentina|2018–19]] }} The '''2017–18 Superliga Argentina''' or '''Campeonato de Primera División Superliga 2017/2018''' (officially the '''Superliga [[Cerveza Quilmes|Quilmes Clásica]]''' for sponsorship reasons){{cite web|url=http://www.ambito.com/899624-quilmes-es-el-nuevo-sponsor-principal-de-la-superliga |title=Quilmes es el nuevo sponsor principal de la Superliga |date=6 October 2017 |publisher=Ámbito |language=Spanish}} was the 128{{small|th}} season of top-flight professional [[football in Argentina]]. The season began on 25 August 2017 and ended on 14 May 2018.{{cite web|url=http://www.afa.org.ar/upload/reglamento/RSL.pdf |title=Reglamento del Campeonato de Primera División 2017–18 |publisher=AFA |language=Spanish}} For the first time since 1893, the AFA did not organise the championship, now being administrated by the [[Superliga Argentina (association)|Superliga Argentina de Fútbol]].{{cite web|url=https://www.lanueva.com/nota/2017-2-24-18-28-0-la-afa-aprobo-la-creacion-de-la-superliga-y-la-rescision-de-futbol-para-todos |title=La AFA aprobó la creación de la Superliga y la rescisión de "Fútbol para Todos" |date=24 February 2017 |publisher=La Nueva |language=Spanish}} Twenty-eight teams competed in the league, twenty-six returning from the [[2016–17 Argentine Primera División|2016–17]] season and two promoted from the [[2016–17 Primera B Nacional]] ([[Argentinos Juniors]] and [[Chacarita Juniors]]). Four teams ([[Aldosivi]], [[Atlético de Rafaela]], [[Quilmes Atlético Club|Quilmes]] and [[Club Atlético Sarmiento (Junín)|Sarmiento]]) were relegated to the Primera B Nacional Championship in the previous tournament. [[Boca Juniors]], who were the defending champions, won their thirty-third league title with one match to spare after a 2–2 draw against [[Club de Gimnasia y Esgrima La Plata|Gimnasia y Esgrima (LP)]] on 9 May 2018.{{cite web |url=https://www.lanacion.com.ar/2132670-gimnasia-boca-por-la-superliga |title=Gimnasia-Boca, por la Superliga: el xeneize empató en La Plata y volvió a gritar campeón |date=9 May 2018 |publisher=La Nación |language=Spanish |access-date=10 May 2018 |archive-date=10 May 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180510231657/https://www.lanacion.com.ar/2132670-gimnasia-boca-por-la-superliga |url-status=dead }} As a result, Boca Juniors qualified for both the [[2019 Copa Libertadores]] and the [[2018 Supercopa Argentina]]. == Competition format == The tournament was contested by 28 teams. Each team played the other 27 teams in a single [[round-robin tournament]]. The additional match against the [[Football rivalries in Argentina|main rival team]] in the so-called "Fecha de Clásicos" was not played in this season.{{cite web|url=http://www.lanacion.com.ar/2048928-la-superliga-definio-su-fixture-sin-la-doble-fecha-de-los-clasicos-y-con-menos-partidos-como-local |title=La Superliga definió su fixture sin la doble fecha de los clásicos y con menos partidos como local |date=August 1, 2017 |publisher=La Nación |language=Spanish}} == Club information == === Stadia and locations === {{location map+ |Argentina |float=right |width=300 |caption=Locations of the 2017–18 Argentine Primera División teams outside [[Greater Buenos Aires]]. |places= {{location map~ |Argentina |lat=-34.603611 |long=-58.381667 |label=
